'''B'Yen Do V'nel''' was the last surviving member of [[j'ber B'Yen]], and the leader of the resistance group [[K'Len J'Bar Kasoon]]. He believed in a more extreme version of the [[M'Nes]] preached by [[j'ber V'Sook]] in which he called for the entire [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] population to rise up and overthrow their [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] oppressors.
